page.description: Parameter defines the page number. Walmart returns up to `40` products per page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.). Maximum `page` value is `100`, while the `pagination` and `the API_pagination` links stop at page `25`, like Walmart's. Use `sort` and `facet` to reach more of a large seller's products.

sort.description: Parameter defines the sorting of the seller's products. It defaults to `best_match`. Available options: `best_match` - Best match `price_low` - Price: low to high `price_high` - Price: high to low `best_seller` - Best seller `rating_high` - Highly rated `new` - New arrivals

facet.description: Parameter defines items filtering based on their attributes. The structure is a list of `key:value` pairs separated by `||`. The key and value are separated by `:` (e.g., `brand:Sony||color:Black`).

include_filters.description: Include `filters` to the JSON response. Set to `true` to enable or `false` to disable (default).

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

catalog_seller_id.description: Parameter defines the Walmart seller to get results for. It's the number after `/seller/` in the seller page link (e.g., `101025813` in `https://www.walmart.com/seller/101025813`), and the `catalog_seller_id` in our Walmart Search API, Walmart Product API, and Walmart Product Sellers API results, **not their `seller_id`**.

# Walmart Seller

Get a Walmart marketplace seller page by seller ID, with seller profile, rating, review count and the seller's product listings.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/walmart/seller" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"catalog_seller_id": "101025813"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.

| `facet` | string | No | Parameter defines items filtering based on their attributes. The structure is a list of `key:value` pairs separated by `//`. The key and value are separated by `:` (e.g., `brand:Sony//color:Black`). |
| `page` | string | No | Parameter defines the page number. Walmart returns up to `40` products per page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.). Maximum `page` value is `100`, while  |
| `json_restrictor` | string | No | Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details. |
| `include_filters` | string | No | Include `filters` to the JSON response. Set to `true` to enable or `false` to disable (default). |
